preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= char <= 'Z' for char in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are uppercase English letters.
The string contains at least three different characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((subseq for subseq in generate_subsequences(s) if is_arithmetic_progression(subseq) and is_descending(subseq)), key=lambda x: (len(x), x))
postconditions.description: The function returns the longest string from the given string with characters arranged in descending order of their ASCII code and in arithmetic progression, with the lowest possible common difference.
